description: Mutes or soloes single channels of a polyphonic cable, all sixteen of them

params.text: Sets how long a mute or unmute fades over, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant
Left-click silences that channel and right-click soloes it; a channel that is both shows red and green, and a left-click from there unmutes it

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable whose channels are muted

outputs.text: The same cable with the muted channels silenced, or with them removed when Shrink channels is ticked

notes: with any channel soloed, every channel that is not soloed is silenced.
the mute buttons have no right-click menu of their own on this version, which is what leaves the right-click free for soloing; MIDI mapping them works as usual.
menu: Show OUT channels — counts the channels leaving the module, in green, instead of the channels arriving
Shrink channels — drops the muted channels out of the cable altogether instead of silencing them, or keeps only the soloed ones
Initialize on Start — comes up with nothing muted or soloed when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming the saved state
Tips — a submenu that only prints a reminder that right-clicking a button soloes its channel
